text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Pendidikan (Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Tahun 2021) 2020.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi

pendidikan bagi tahun 2021.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan bagi tahun 2021 adalah sebagaimana yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Kumpulan A Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Johor,

Kedah, Kelantan dan Terengganu

 20 Januari 2021 hingga 25 Mac 2021

 4 April 2021 hingga 27 Mei 2021

 Penggal Kedua

 13 Jun 2021 hingga 15 Julai 2021

 25 Julai 2021 hingga 9 September 2021

 19 September 2021 hingga 9 Disember 2021

Kumpulan B Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Melaka,

Negeri Sembilan, Pahang, Perak,

Perlis, Pulau Pinang, Sabah, Sarawak,

Selangor, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala

Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan

dan Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya

 20 Januari 2021 hingga 26 Mac 2021

 5 April 2021 hingga 28 Mei 2021

 Penggal Kedua

 14 Jun 2021 hingga 16 Julai 2021

 26 Julai 2021 hingga 10 September 2021

 20 September 2021 hingga 10 Disember 2021

Dibuat 30 Julai 2020

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/8(14); PN(PU2)569/XIV]

DR. MOHD RADZI BIN MD JIDIN

Menteri Kanan Pendidikan

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS YEAR 2021)

REGULATIONS 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the

Education Act 1996 [Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions for the

year 2021.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the year 2021 shall be as

specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Group A First Term

All educational institutions in Johore, Kedah,

Kelantan and Terengganu

20 January 2021 to 25 March 2021

 4 April 2021 to 27 May 2021

 Second Term

13 June 2021 to 15 July 2021

25 July 2021 to 9 September 2021

19 September 2021 to 9 December 2021

1. These Regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Year 2021) Regulations 2020.

Group B First Term

All educational institutions in Malacca,

Negeri Sembilan, Pahang, Perak, Perlis,

Penang, Sabah, Sarawak, Selangor, Federal

Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Federal

Territory of Labuan and Federal Territory of

Putrajaya

20 January 2021 to 26 March 2021

 5 April 2021 to 28 May 2021

 Second Term

14 June 2021 to 16 July 2021

26 July 2021 to 10 September 2021

20 September 2021 to 10 December 2021

Made 30 July 2020

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/8(14); PN(PU2)569/XIV]

DR. MOHD RADZI BIN MD JIDIN

Senior Minister of Education
